caption: A lantern inside a tent is turned up to full brightness, and sharp shadows of the tent poles appear on the canvas.

sa.check: A lantern is inside a tent.
It is turned up to full brightness.
Shadows of the tent poles appear on the canvas.
The lantern brightens first and the shadows appear with it.

pc.expect: The shadows appear as the lantern brightens and fall away from it.
pc.fail: They are there with the lantern dim; or they point toward the lantern; or the lantern brightens and no shadows appear.

pc.expect: The shadows are the poles' outlines, one per pole, sharpening as the light strengthens.
pc.fail: There are more shadows than poles; or they are unrelated shapes; or they stay blurred at full brightness.

pc.expect: The shadows do not move with the lantern and poles fixed, and would shift if the lantern moved.
pc.fail: They drift by themselves; or swing round; or change with nothing moving.

pc.expect: The shadows sharpen and darken as the lantern is turned up, and would fade if it were dimmed.
pc.fail: They fade as the lantern brightens; or flicker with a steady lantern; or appear fully sharp before the lantern is turned up.

pc.expect: One lantern and the tent's poles.
pc.fail: A pole vanishes; or a second lantern appears; or a shadow becomes solid; or the lantern passes through the canvas.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The canvas and the lantern stay the same, and the shadows stay dark.
pc.fail: The canvas changes colour; or the shadows turn coloured; or the lantern changes shape.
